forecast.provenance: Weekly next-week horizon confirmed by the product owner. Demonstration uses supplied Oct 12 targets; no new weekend model run is represented.
forecast.comparison: Latest available target snapshots per fund. Prior target dates vary; these are model allocations, not confirmed holdings.

definitions.buyCount: Fund codes with an increased model target weight; not executed buys.
definitions.sellCount: Fund codes with a reduced model target weight; not executed sales.
definitions.unchangedCount: Comparable fund codes without a weight change, including zero-to-zero weights.
definitions.averageChangePp: Sum of target-weight changes divided by all comparable fund codes, including unchanged codes. Equal weighted, not weighted by assets.
definitions.netChangePp: Sum of percentage-point target-weight changes across fund codes. This is not a percentage flow or dollar flow.
definitions.agreementPct: Larger directional fund count divided by changing fund count. Descriptive agreement, not probability or model confidence.
definitions.buyBreadthPct: Increasing fund-code count divided by all comparable fund codes.
definitions.direction: Add/reduce by majority of changing fund-code counts; mixed when tied.
definitions.addRank: Descending add count, then descending sum of target changes; descriptive ranking only.
definitions.reduceRank: Descending reduce count, then ascending sum of target changes; descriptive ranking only.
definitions.holdings: Union of previous and latest model target positions, excluding cash. Missing securities count as zero only within full target snapshots.
definitions.history: Signal history contains historical model-target changes. Fund history contains historical simulated and reported unadjusted NAV, never future realized performance.

limitations: The presentation derives expected changes from each fund’s latest two available model targets. It does not contain actual transactions.
The next-week horizon comes from the product owner. The Oct 19–23 demo window is explicitly illustrative; the source target snapshot is Oct 12, not a newly executed weekend forecast.
Prior target dates vary by fund. Missing weeks are not filled; target differences must not be described as actual weekly trading activity.
No probabilities, calibrated accuracy, confidence intervals, share volumes, AUM, market prices or dollar flows are supplied.
Fund-code counts can include multiple share classes and correlated strategies; they do not measure independent institutional decisions.
All sector and asset-class classifications are unavailable in the source; securities are identified by source ID and ticker only.
Simulated NAV excludes transaction costs. Actual NAV is unadjusted and excludes the total-return effect of distributions.
NAV ends September 18, 2026. It has not been recalculated to include the latest target updates and cannot validate their accuracy.
Historical comparison coverage varies. Missing months are not bridged, filled or extrapolated.
Original fund names and managers are snapshot metadata. Independently sourced credentials are provided separately; they do not validate model accuracy.
